Session date: 3:56 pm on 4 November, 2022
[D26:6] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a turtle laying on a bed of rocks and gravel
[D26:7] Joanna: Yup, I still remember this story from when I was 10. It was about a brave little turtle who was scared but explored the world anyway. Maybe even back then, I was inspired by stories about finding courage and taking risks. It's still a part of my writing today.
[D26:8] Nate: You obviously have a passion for writing, and it's funny the story was about a turtle! Their resilience is so inspiring! Take courage and keep pushing yourself with your writing. Great job!
[...]
[D26:20] Nate: I don't see why not! I'm not doing anything then, so your completely welcome to!
[D26:21] Joanna: Awesome! I'll bring some of my recipes so we can both share deserts!
[D26:22] Nate: I'd love that! I've been wanting to try some of your chocolate and rasberry cake for a while now.
[...]
Session date: 8:10 pm on 7 November, 2022
[D27:4] Joanna: Sounds like you're really loving life right now! It's great when you find something that suits you. Being busy can be tiring but it's so rewarding in the end. Keep it up!
[D27:4] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a book with a black border and a white title
[D27:5] Nate: Thanks, Joanna! I'm really grateful to have a job I enjoy every day. So anyways, anything new going on in your life?
[...]
[D27:7] Nate: Woah Joanna, that's incredible! I remember when you started working on these sorta things. It's crazy to see how far you've gotten! You've really got a thing for writing, huh? Where'd you get the idea for it?
[D27:7] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a turtle laying on a bed of rocks and gravel
[D27:8] Joanna: Thanks Nate! Writing has always been a passion of mine. I got the idea for this script from a dream. How have your turtles been? I haven't seen pictures of them in a while!

Session date: 5:54 pm on 9 November, 2022
[D28:20] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a sunflower in a field with a sunset in the background
[D28:21] Nate: Wow, that sunset pic looks incredible! What inspired you to take that photo?
[D28:22] Joanna: Thanks, Nate! I took that pic on a hike last summer near Fort Wayne. The sunset and the surrounding beauty were just incredible. It was an awesome reminder of nature's beauty.
[...]
Session date: 12:06 am on 11 November, 2022
[D29:4] Nate: I think so too! What's been the coolest moment on set?
[D29:4] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a fish tank with a fish inside of it
[D29:5] Joanna: One of the actors came up to me and told me how much she liked my script! I was so excited when that happened - it gave me chills!
[D29:6] Nate: Wow Joanna, that must have been so exciting! It's incredible when you get those moments of joy. Anyway, I took my turtles to the beach in Tampa yesterday! They always bring me peace in the craziness of life.
[D29:6] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a turtle in a sink with a reflection of its head
[D29:7] Joanna: Woah, that's awesome, Nate! You must really enjoy having them around - they're so cool! What do you love most about having them?
[D29:8] Nate: Your completely right! I really love having them around. They're so cool and they make me feel calm. Plus, they don't require much looking after, which is great. I love seeing them soaking in the sun like this.
[D29:8] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a turtle sitting on a log in a pond
[D29:9] Joanna: That's awesome, Nate! They look so serene and happy. It's great to have something like that.

Session date: 2:34 pm on 10 July, 2022
[D17:21] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a person holding a small turtle in a container
Session date: 6:12 pm on 14 August, 2022
[D18:1] Joanna: Hey Nate, long time no talk! I've been busy with writing projects and really going all out with it. It's been the best thing ever - a mix of highs and lows - and my journal's pretty much my rock. Writing's such a huge part of me now.
[D18:1] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a notebook with a bunch of stickers on it
[D18:2] Nate: Hey Joanna! Great to hear it! It's amazing how much a certain activity can become a part of our lives. Keep it up, you're inspiring! Is writing your way to solace and creativity?
[D18:3] Joanna: Yeah, definitely. Writing has become like an escape and a way to express my feelings. It gives me a chance to put all my thoughts and feelings down and make something good out of it. Words just have a magical way of healing.
[...]
[D18:6] Nate: Nice work, Joanna! That must feel sureal. Keep it up - you're changing lives!
[D18:7] Joanna: Thanks, Nate! Really appreciate your kind words. It's knowing that my writing can make a difference that keeps me going, even on tough days. So glad to have this outlet to share my stories and hopefully have an impact. How about you? Anything new since we last talked?
[D18:8] Nate: Thanks, Joanna! Your words mean a lot. Since we last spoke, I started teaching people how to make this. Sharing my love for dairy-free desserts has been fun and rewarding.
[...]
[D18:9] Joanna: Yum, Nate! I love it when you make coconut milk icecream, it's so good!
[D18:10] Nate: I've been really into making this lately - it's creamy, rich, dairy-free and a new recipe! Wanna try it? I can share the recipe with you if you'd like!
[D18:11] Joanna: I'd love to try it! Thanks for sharing your love for dairy-free desserts. I really appreciate it!
[D18:12] Nate: No problem, Joanna! Always happy to share them with you. Sending you the recipe now!
[D18:13] Joanna: Thanks, Nate! Can't wait to surprise my family with something delicious!

Session date: 1:43 pm on 24 March, 2022
[D6:9] Nate: Wow, that's a lot of books. Do you have any advice for someone like me who wants to pursue writing?
[D6:10] Joanna: Definitely! Read lots and try out different genres. Build a solid understanding of literature. Don't be afraid to write and share, even if it's just with friends. Practicing and gathering feedback will make you better. Have faith in yourself and continue following your writing dreams - it's tough but worth it.
[D6:11] Nate: Thanks, Joanna. Really appreciate your help and kind words. I'm going to keep working hard on it and see what happens. Good luck with your project, I'm sure it will turn out great!
[...]
Session date: 6:44 pm on 17 April, 2022
[D8:13] Nate: Speaking of which, here they go again!
[D8:13] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a turtle and a strawberry in a bowl
[D8:14] Joanna: So cute! I love your turtles so much!
[D8:15] Nate: Me too! I love watching them play to simply enjoy the peaceful moments of life. Sometimes I even bring them in the kitchen so they can watch me make food like this!
[D8:15] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a bowl of ice cream and a bowl of sprinkles
[D8:16] Joanna: I love your icecream so much! I wish I could make it the way you do!
[...]
Session date: 7:44 pm on 21 April, 2022
[D9:1] Joanna: Hey Nate! Long time no talk! I wanted to tell ya I just joined a writers group. It's unbelievable--such inspirational people who really get my writing. I'm feeling so motivated and supported, it's like I finally belong somewhere!
[D9:1] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a notebook with a notepad and a piece of paper
[D9:2] Nate: Hey Joanna! That's awesome! Having a supportive group around you can really make a difference. What kind of projects are you working on with them?
[D9:2] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a cup of ice cream with a cherry on top
[D9:3] Joanna: Thanks, Nate! We've made some great progress. I'm working on one with my group called "Finding Home." It's a script about a girl on a journey to find her true home. I find it really rewarding and emotional. What about you? Any upcoming gaming tournaments?

Session date: 7:44 pm on 21 April, 2022
[D9:5] Image caption (automatic): a photography of a man in a striped suit is performing on stage
[D9:6] Nate: Sounds like you had an interesting time on stage! It's always a learning experience. Have you ever considered going back to acting? Is that you in the photo?
[D9:7] Joanna: Yeah, that's me in that photo! Acting was my first passion, but now I really shine in writing. It helps me express myself in a new way, but who knows, maybe I'll go back to acting someday. Never say never!
[...]
Session date: 11:54 am on 2 May, 2022

[D10:4] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a woman with purple hair and a black dress
[D10:5] Joanna: Wow, congrats! What game were you playing?
[...]
[D10:9] Joanna: Not much is new other than the screenplay. Been working on some projects and testing out dairy-free dessert recipes for friends and fam. Here's a pic of a cake I made recently!
[D10:9] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a cake with white frosting on a wooden table
[D10:10] Nate: That looks really good! I love the way the frosting turned out!
[...]

[D11:5] Joanna: Yeah, I did! Loved this spot on the hike. The rush of the water was so soothing.
